corpus.split_note: Additional authored evaluation cases, separate from development tests/examples; not external or blind evaluation.
corpus.correction_note: Two slash/tilde component-name fixtures are invalid, not supported comparisons. Added two valid escaped-property reference cases. Labels corrected from the specification before further scoring or engine fixes; v1 artifacts retained.

timing_note: Local in-process parse, offline validation, normalization and comparison. Includes first-use cost; excludes worker startup, HTTP, database and AI. No warm-up samples discarded.

summary.scope: Exact policy labels in this original frozen corpus only; not general OpenAPI accuracy or an external benchmark.
